# Copilot Instructions

- Always use the `uv` tool (from Astral) for running Python scripts and installing packages.
- Use `uv add <package>` instead of `pip install <package>`.
- Use `uv run <command>` instead of `python <command>` or `python3 <command>`.
- Do not use `pip`, `pipenv`, or `poetry` for package management or script execution.=
